results.name: Clear criteria preserves committed question, format and sort while clearing all other filters
Delegated platform buttons preserve question/vehicle/format and reset pagination
Platform facets render matching pressed state, counts, and selected zero-result source
Facet refresh restores the equivalent platform/category button only inside the open drawer
Desktop filter drawer moves original controls, survives breakpoint, and restores focus
Filter badge excludes question, format, language and vehicle context
Suggestion request keeps whole question, exact spec, vehicle and selected source/format
Keyword completion/correction are escaped and keyboard selection preserves precise context
Video suggestion exposes source, estimated language and escaped author before opening exact ID
Unknown video language is never rendered as French by default
Show results suggestion action submits the original form and remembers the exact draft
A slower stale suggestion response cannot replace the newer query suggestions
Suggestion group and source-language labels follow EN/ES UI independently of content language

scope.executed: Production app setFilter/renderFacets, reset-filter and delegated click handlers extracted without modification; real mobile/discovery modules.
scope.doubles: Minimal DOM/events; rendering/load/network callbacks controlled; no full app bootstrap or API engine execution.
scope.limits: Does not establish layout, native browser focus trapping, computed accessibility or real network results.
